zh.firstAction: 先确认发布窗口，再执行放行。

en.sub: Overall passed with zero failures and freshness is fresh, ready for standard flow.

vi.sub: Tong the dat, khong co muc loi va freshness la fresh, co the theo quy trinh chuan.

zh.firstAction: 优先处理 topFailedChecks 首项，修复后重跑 check-family。

vi.sub: Can xac nhan do tuoi hoac tom tat

zh.sub: 当前结果需复核后再判定发布，尤其 stale 场景不应直接放行或拦截。
zh.firstAction: 先重跑 check-family，刷新后再依据最新结果决定是否发布。

en.sub: Current result needs manual review before release decision, especially in stale scenarios.
en.firstAction: Rerun check-family first, then decide release using refreshed output.

vi.sub: Can ra soat thu cong truoc khi quyet dinh phat hanh, dac biet voi truong hop stale.
vi.firstAction: Chay lai check-family truoc, sau do moi quyet dinh phat hanh theo ket qua moi.

staleFirstReminder.zh: freshness=stale 表示结果时效不足，不等于系统故障；先重跑 check-family，再决定是否发布。
staleFirstReminder.en: freshness=stale means stale evidence, not necessarily a system fault; rerun check-family first, then decide release.
staleFirstReminder.vi: freshness=stale co nghia la bang chung da cu, khong dong nghia loi he thong; hay chay lai check-family truoc, roi moi quyet dinh phat hanh.
